items.name: Rollon linear motion product line
items.claim: Timken's Rollon brand is a leader in highly customized linear motion guides, telescopic rails, actuators and systems, expanding growth opportunities in robotics and automation market sectors.
items.source_excerpt: As a leader in highly customized linear motion guides, telescopic rails, actuators and systems, Rollon has expanded growth opportunities in attractive market sectors such as robotics and automation.

items.name: Intelligent Machine Solutions (iMS) acquisition, robotic transfer units
items.claim: Timken acquired Intelligent Machine Solutions (iMS), expanding Rollon's linear motion product range with larger and heavy-duty applications such as seventh-axis robotic transfer units (RTUs) and gantry systems.
items.source_excerpt: The addition of iMS expands and complements Timken's Rollon® linear motion product range with larger and heavy-duty applications, such as seventh-axis robotic transfer units (RTUs) and gantry systems.

notes: Timken's Q2 2026 8-K (stored) carries no backlog/order text; both items are Timken's own press releases on the Rollon linear-motion / robotics product line, stored 2026-09-14 (REQ-20260914-1376/1377).
